title: Fixes #16856 — pollinations-api REST skill for agents without CLI install
author: aikhusus2025-ctrl

gist.summary: Added the `pollinations-api` Agent Skill so agents in sandboxes without npm install permission can call Pollinations directly, without installing `polli` or completing browser-based CLI login. The skill starts with keyless `GET /image/{prompt}`, documents OpenAI-compatible `POST /v1/chat/completions` using `Authorization: Bearer $KEY`, and points agents to `/v1/models`, `openapi.json`, and `docs/llm.txt`. It uses the existing `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` discovery mechanism; the index now lists both skills, and `/llms.txt` links to the new one. Tests verify both indexed skill digests against the served files.

image.prompt: In a cozy garden hackerspace, a small bee guides a curious CRT monitor robot from a pixel sign marked 'SKILLS' to a glowing lime green (#ecf874) image URL, with code-plants growing around the terminal. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny librarian glasses and shares the frame with the robot. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
